h: Lagos reportedly plans 30-minute driver's licences and 10-minute renewals from 2027
p: The Lagos State government is said to be working on a much faster driver's licence process that would start in 2027. New licences would reportedly be issued in about 30 minutes, while renewals would take around 10. No further details on cost or locations have been given yet.
more: The state has been talking about issuing its own licences in partnership with the federal government.
Drivers currently often wait weeks or months for a card.
